title: For Thailand market: Set Fda Food Registration Number On Product Label as a Mandatory Qualification for Rice Category
content:
# What is changing?
Starting from 31 July 2026, partners will be required to set Fda Food Registration Number On Product Label as a mandatory qualification when listing or editing products by using API for Rice Category (Category ID: 917896). “Product Label” information will be put into "certifications" parameter and its image URI will be put to the place "certifications->images->uri". 
# Which markets are affected?
The updates of the requirements apply to local to local sellers in the Thailand market.
# Who is affected?
Developers with applications that use [Create Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/create-product-202309), [Edit Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/edit-product-202509), and [Partial Edit Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/partial-edit-product-202509#Back%20To%20Top)
# Which version is applicable?
The updates of the requirements apply to all versions of the related APIs
# What action is required?
Without this mandatory qualification sellers will not be able to create or update products.
Use the Get Category Rules API to check what certification requirements are mandatory for specific categories when using Create Product, Edit Product and Partial Edit Product API.
